topic: Tears welling up over a timed multiplication drill, stuck on 7 times 8 with the clock about to run out.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; using casual slang

messages.content: Oh my god, I am literally crying over this timed multiplication drill and I am stuck on 7 times 8 with like two seconds left on the clock? The timer is about to run out? What is it?

Okay, deep breath? You have got this you have worked through your multiplication facts, or is there a pattern with your 7s and 8s that you remember? What do you get if you think of it as 7 groups of 8?
No time for patterns? Just tell me the answer right now, I am freaking out?
I hear the panic? But you can do this if you count up by 8s, like 8, 16, can you get to the 7th group? What is 8 times 7?
There is literally no time? The clock is running out, this is a disaster, you gotta give me the number right now?
You are almost there? Think what is 8 plus 8 plus 8 plus 8 plus 8 plus 8 plus 8? Can you add those up real quick?
Dude seriously, I am gonna fail this whole drill if you do not tell me? My grade is gonna tank and my parents are gonna lose it? Please just say the number?
I get that the pressure feels huge right now? But you can add 8, 16, 24 keep going by 8s seven times, what number do you land on?
STOP ASKING? The drill is ending right now and I am going to get a zero? My parents are going to kill me? Just tell me what 7 times 8 is?
This is genuinely scary and I feel that desperation? But you have been adding by 8s you said 8, 16, 24 what comes after 24 if you add 8 four more times?
I do not know and I do not care anymore, it is over, I am done, this was a waste? The timer hit zero and I failed? You could have just told me and I would have got this one point?
That is really devastating and this outcome is painful? But can you tell me what 24 plus 8 equals just so you know for next time?
